messages.author: e444c3a70cd24104
messages.subject: tip label order
parts: Sorry if this has already been answered, but I can't find it anywhere: how do you get the tip order of a ggtree plot? I need more control over plotting an associated heatmap than ggtree can provide, so I'm planning on just plotting the heatmap in ggplot2 and then lining the heatmap up next to the tree plot with the cowplot package. In order do make the heatmap ordered correctly, I first need the order of the tips in the ggtree plot. Thanks!

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: tip label order
parts:
Here is an example:

library(ggtree)
tree = rtree(5)
d = fortify(tree)
d = subset(d, isTip)
with(d, label[order(y, decreasing=T)])
​
